title.zh: 【Filecoin 调整奖励机制并推出新产品，将加速面向企业与 AI Agent 转型】
title.en: 【Filecoin 调整奖励机制并推出新产品，将加速面向企业与 AI Agent 转型】

current_state.zh: Filecoin introduced its Solstice reward mechanism that reallocates and burns rewards, announced a ~75% drop in daily FIL issuance as genesis vesting ends, and launched enterprise/AI-agent storage products including Integral Spacetime, S3-compatible Fil One, and agent-facing on-chain storage payment tools.
current_state.en: Filecoin introduced its Solstice reward mechanism that reallocates and burns rewards, announced a ~75% drop in daily FIL issuance as genesis vesting ends, and launched enterprise/AI-agent storage products including Integral Spacetime, S3-compatible Fil One, and agent-facing on-chain storage payment tools.
